t: What Zero-Emission Synthetic Jet Fuel Is
title: What Zero-Emission Synthetic Jet Fuel Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Zero-emission synthetic jet fuel (e-kerosene/SAF) makes aviation fuel from air and water: green hydrogen plus captured CO2 synthesized into drop-in jet fuel — flying without fossil carbon. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Zero-Emission Synthetic Jet Fuel: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Zero-Emission Synthetic Jet Fuel in one line: Zero-emission synthetic jet fuel (e-kerosene/SAF) makes aviation fuel from air and water: green hydrogen plus captured CO2 synthesized into drop-in jet fuel — flying without fossil carbon.
Why it matters: Aviation cannot electrify long-haul; synthetic fuel is its only clean path..
Where it is used: aviation, shipping, long-haul transport..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
